recognize_zh: 腎臟切片的 PAX5 免疫染色：間質內密集浸潤的小淋巴球幾乎全部呈棕色核染色，腎小管上皮則為陰性；表示這片浸潤主要是 B 細胞，支持 B 細胞淋巴瘤浸潤。
features: Dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate with strong diffuse nuclear PAX5 staining
Nearly all infiltrating small cells are positive, indicating a B-cell population
Residual tubules and vessels are negative and entrapped within the infiltrate
Uninvolved renal parenchyma at the edges is negative
describe_en: PAX5 immunohistochemistry on the kidney core biopsy shows strong, diffuse nuclear staining in nearly all cells of the dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate. Entrapped tubules, vessels, and adjacent uninvolved parenchyma are negative. The sheet-like PAX5-positive population indicates that the infiltrate is composed predominantly of B cells. In combination with CD5 co-expression, the findings support renal involvement by CLL/SLL.

ddx.vs: Reactive interstitial infiltrates are T-cell predominant with only scattered PAX5-positive B cells, not a sheet of B cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is also PAX5- and CD5-positive but expresses cyclin D1 and SOX11.
Marginal zone lymphoma is PAX5-positive but typically CD5-negative and LEF1-negative.
